verdict.rationale: Exa documents per-key controls: you can review usage and set a lower limit on an individual API key (exa-docs-42). It also offers a Team Management API (exa-docs-38) and a command that provisions an API key into a project (exa-docs-33). Together these suggest you can issue a separate, usage-capped key for an agent. That is only a thin form of scoping, though, since the evidence shows no permission or endpoint restrictions. Missing for 10: permission/endpoint-scoped keys (e.g., search-only or read-only), documented least-privilege role model for keys, key expiry/rotation controls, independent corroboration.
